name: @cardananium/cquisitor-lib
description: Workspace of @cardananium/cquisitor-lib (Cardano transaction validation, ledger-type and CBOR decoding, CDDL validation, UPLC decoding; Rust/wasm core with a typed TypeScript API). The published package is assembled in pkg/ and published from there.

scripts.rust:build-wasm:node: rimraf ./pkg/node ./pkg/wasm/node && WASM_BINDGEN_WEAKREF=1 wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/node && npm run check-wasm-stack -- pkg/node/cquisitor_lib_bg.wasm
scripts.rust:build-wasm:browser: rimraf ./pkg/browser ./pkg/wasm/browser && WASM_BINDGEN_WEAKREF=1 wasm-pack build --target browser --out-dir pkg/browser && npm run check-wasm-stack -- pkg/browser/cquisitor_lib_bg.wasm
scripts.rust:build-wasm: npm run rust:build-wasm:node && npm run rust:build-wasm:browser
scripts.build-all: npm run clean && npm run generate-dts && npm run rust:build-wasm && npm run assemble && npm run pack
scripts.generate-dts: npm run generate-schemas && npm run schemas-to-dts

author: Evgenii Lisitskii
